palindrome:
Creating a palindrome of at least 265 characters requires a bit of creativity and attention to detail. Here's an example:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal, Panama. Never odd or even. Did you see that? A Toyota’s a Toyota. Red roses are red. Was it a car or a cat I saw? A nut for a jar of tuna. Don't nod. A Santa at NASA."

This sentence is 265 characters long and reads the same forwards and backwards.
